title: Campus
alt: Buildings around Northrop Mall at the University of Minnesota, as plain blocks on a square plate
about: 35 buildings, the streets and the footpaths in a 500 m square around Northrop Mall, from Northrop to Coffman Union, written by our exporter at 1:1000. In AR the plate is 50 cm wide. Click a building to highlight it and see its name.

title: Terrain
alt: The area around Northrop Mall at the University of Minnesota on ground that follows the terrain, with buildings, streets and footpaths each in one colour
about: The same 500 m square around Northrop Mall, with the ground shaped by USGS elevation data, written by our exporter at 1:1000. In AR the plate is 50 cm wide. Each kind of feature has one colour: ground, roads, footpaths and buildings, so buildings cannot be picked one by one.

title: Coffman
alt: Coffman Memorial Union at the University of Minnesota as one plain block, on a square of ground with the streets and footpaths around it
about: One building on its own: Coffman Memorial Union with the ground, streets and footpaths up to 30 m around it, found by name and written by our exporter at 1:306. In AR the plate is 50 cm wide.

title: Building
alt: 3D model of a four-storey apartment building
about: A sample model from an open-source kit, to compare with our own output.

title: Test block
alt: Test model: a maroon block with a gold marker on one corner
about: Written by our GLB exporter to check scale and orientation. In AR it should be 20 cm wide and lie flat, with the gold marker on its north-east corner.
